title: Charter School Partnerships Dashboard
intro: This dashboard describes the six charter schools Saint Louis University sponsors, their students and their reported results, alongside the programs OSCP provides. Use the menu to open a dashboard, and the filters to choose a school or school building. Missouri figures are shown for comparison only.
